summary: Account is brand new (9 IG, 1 LI, 1 BS followers). Only 5 posts in 30 days — too little data for patterns. Instagram bio violates brand rules: names specific niches (hotels, cafes, gyms, homestays), region (Himachal), promises '24 hrs' delivery, and offers free site check outside website posts.
guidance:
- Rotate hook styles: try 'Contrast' or 'Myth Bust' for lead gen (last used: Question, Story).
- Avoid repeating 'same 5 questions' or 'blank screen' phrasing; they've appeared recently.
- Keep posts reading like a developer sharing real work, never an ad.
- High skip rates (63–75%) mean first 3 seconds need stronger visual/verbal hooks.
- Shares drive reach (51% share rate on clock reel); craft share-worthy insights.
- No demos, free audits, or niche targeting — only 'pay after approval' or a short DM conversation.

instructions.research: Find 2-3 common lead-generation pain points Indian small businesses mention in public forums (e.g. WhatsApp Business queries, IndiaMART, Justdial reviews) — no niche focus.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two published chatbot posts (Question hook) vs the website Myth Bust post: note which format (image vs text) got any profile visits or follows, even if tiny.
instructions.writer: Write one lead-gen post using 'Contrast' hook: contrast manual lead tracking (notebooks, spreadsheets, missed follow-ups) with a simple automated sheet — no tool names, no guarantees, end with 'pay after approval' CTA.
instructions.image: Create a single static image: split screen — left side messy notebook/spreadsheet, right side clean lead sheet with columns (Name, Source, Status, Next Action). Minimal text, developer aesthetic.
instructions.video: Skip video today; static image fits Contrast hook faster and avoids high skip-rate risk.

manual_tips: Update Instagram bio to: 'Websites, AI chatbots, animated ads & lead systems for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for honest advice.'
Comment thoughtfully on 3 posts by Indian small business owners (any industry) discussing lead follow-up struggles — no pitching, just empathy.
Reply to the 1 comment on your chatbot post (if any) with a genuine question about their current process.
